resources.string: Join me on WeTalk! Fast, secure messaging and HD voice/video calls. Download now: https://wetalk.app

WeTalk is a modern real-time messaging and calling platform designed for fast, reliable, and secure communication. Built natively for Android using Java, Firebase, Agora RTC Engine, and Cloudinary media cloud storage.
Developed with ❤️ by Tech Titans Team
© 2025 Tech Titans Team. All Rights Reserved.
WeTalk collects essential account information such as your display name, email address, profile photo, and FCM push notification tokens strictly to deliver messaging and calling services.

Your personal data is used solely to facilitate 1-on-1 direct messaging, private group chats, 24-hour status updates, and call signaling. We do not sell or share your personal data with third parties.
Shared media attachments (images, videos, documents) are securely stored via Cloudinary CDN and cached locally on your device in Room Database for instant offline viewing.
WeTalk integrates trusted third-party SDKs including Firebase Authentication, Firebase Realtime Database, Agora RTC Engine for HD calling, and Cloudinary for media delivery.
How do I start a voice or video call?
Open any direct 1-on-1 chat or group chat, and tap the Voice Call or Video Call icon in the top toolbar to start an HD call.
Navigate to the Status tab, tap \'My Status\' to upload an image, and it will automatically expire and delete after 24 hours.
Yes! All your conversation messages are stored locally using Room Database, allowing you to read chats instantly without internet access.
How do I manage group permissions?
Group admins can edit group details, update group avatars, and add or remove members directly from the Group Info screen.

Allow incoming voice and video calls to ring over lock screen
